description: The device id sent as the `unique_id` header by a device runtime (`react-client`). Generation: 16 characters drawn from a 63-character alphabet with rejection sampling (a random byte >= 252 is discarded, otherwise `alphabet[byte % 63]`). Validity (`isUniqueId`): a string of 1 to 64 characters, every character in the range 0x21..0x7E (printable ASCII, no space, no control character). An invalid persisted value is replaced by a fresh id. The id is persisted under the storage key `i18n-keyless-user-id` and is NOT removed when the translation cache is cleared. A server runtime sends no id.
resolutionRules: the process-level id, once set, wins over any store snapshot
else a valid id from the store snapshot is adopted and becomes the process-level id
else a fresh id is generated and becomes the process-level id
an empty header is never sent
